ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Handle it according to the vertex method of linear programming. From the meaning of the problem, read the three half-planes: x-y+1≥0, namely x≥y-1; y+1≥0, namely y≥-1; x+y+1≤0, namely x≤-y-1. Find the pairwise intersection points of the boundary lines and screen the feasible vertices: y=-1 and x+y+1=0 intersect to give (0,-1); y=-1 and x-y+1=0 intersect to give (-2,-1); x-y+1=0 and x+y+1=0 intersect to give (-1,0). These three points all satisfy the constraints and form a closed triangular feasible region. The maximum value of the linear objective function 2x-y is attained at a vertex. Calculate respectively: at (0,-1), 2x-y=0-(-1)=1; at (-2,-1), 2x-y=-4+1=-3; at (-1,0), 2x-y=-2. The maximum value is 1.

method.method_draft: 作线性规划的顶点法。先从题干文字读取三个半平面：x-y+1≥0，即 x≥y-1；y+1≥0，即 y≥-1；x+y+1≤0，即 x≤-y-1。求这些边界直线的交点并筛选可行顶点：y=-1 与 x+y+1=0 得 (0,-1)；y=-1 与 x-y+1=0 得 (-2,-1)；x-y+1=0 与 x+y+1=0 得 (-1,0)。线性目标函数 2x-y 在封闭三角形可行域上的最大值必在顶点取得。分别代入：在 (0,-1) 得 1，在 (-2,-1) 得 -3，在 (-1,0) 得 -2，所以最大值为 1。
method.CoT_raw: 按线性规划顶点法处理。由题意读取三个半平面：x-y+1≥0，即 x≥y-1；y+1≥0，即 y≥-1；x+y+1≤0，即 x≤-y-1。求边界直线两两交点并筛选可行顶点：y=-1 与 x+y+1=0 相交得 (0,-1)；y=-1 与 x-y+1=0 相交得 (-2,-1)；x-y+1=0 与 x+y+1=0 相交得 (-1,0)。这三个点都满足约束条件，构成封闭三角形可行域。线性目标函数 2x-y 的最大值在顶点处取得。分别计算：在 (0,-1) 处，2x-y=0-(-1)=1；在 (-2,-1) 处，2x-y=-4+1=-3；在 (-1,0) 处，2x-y=-2。最大值为 1。
